chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Abū Jamīlah, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
If you shun the major sins which you are forbidden from, We shall expiate from you your evil deeds and admit you to a noble entrance.
He عليه السلام said: "The major sins are those for which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has made the Fire obligatory."

key_terms.أَوْجَبَ: made obligatory; rendered certain as a consequence
key_terms.النَّارَ: the Fire; punishment in the hereafter
key_terms.تُجْتَنِبُوا: you avoid completely; you keep away from
key_terms.سَيِّئَاتِكُمْ: your evil deeds; lesser sins that are forgiven
key_terms.كَبَائِرَ: major sins; the gravest prohibited acts mentioned in the verse
key_terms.مُدْخَلًا كَرِيمًا: a noble entrance; an honorable admittance into the hereafter
key_terms.نُكَفِّرْ: We expiate; We cover and remove the effect of sins

ai.seo_question: How does Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام define the major sins in Qur'an 4:31?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about avoiding major sins by defining الكبائر as those sins for which Allah عزّ وجلّ has obligated the Fire. It highlights the grave spiritual consequence of such acts and clarifies the verse through the teaching of Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameela, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the Words of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
[4:31] If you shun the great sins which you are Forbidden, We will do away with your (small) sins and Cause you to enter an honourable place of entering.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The major sins are those upon which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Obligated the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from abu Jamilah from al-Halabi from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “About the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy,
‘If you avoid violating that which has been prohibited, your (lesser) sins will be forgiven and you will be admitted into a graceful dwelling,’ [4:31]
the Imam said, ‘Major sins are those for which Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has made it necessary that the sinner suffer the torment of the fire.’”
